claims.claim: Two lion machine with overlapping table
claims.evidence: Witness report describes an antique-style treadle sewing machine on a wooden cabinet/stand; no clear brand/model or “overlapping table” feature is readable in the provided observations.
No brand/model markings or country-of-origin text is visible/readable in the witness report.
Witness report only shows the machine/cabinet and pedal area; it does not include a running test or sound/operation clip.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show included accessories (needle, bobbins, presser feet, attachments, tools) or the manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No internal condition check, service history document, or operational test is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete parts (needle, bobbin case, presser feet, attachments, belt/treadle components) that affect usability and value.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the full accessory set laid out (needle, bobbins, bobbin case, presser feet, attachments) plus a clear view of the treadle/belt/drive components and the needle/bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: parts missing) and treat as for parts or limited use.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition/wear (feed mechanism, internal gears, needle bar, rust) may be poor even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of operation: treadle/handwheel movement with the feed moving, plus close-ups of the needle bar/feed dogs and any visible internal wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working; assume higher chance of needing servicing/repairs.

risks.risk: Cabinet/wood damage (cracks, loose joints, missing drawer/parts) not visible from the single angle.
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles: underside, back, drawer open/closed, and close-ups of joints/cracks/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cabinet condition unknown; assume possible wood wear/damage.

risks.risk: Brand/model and country-of-origin uncertainty (value depends heavily on exact markings).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of all labels/engraving/serial plates on the machine head and cabinet (including any “Two lion”/Japanese markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown brand due to unreadable markings.

risks.risk: If converted to electric, electrical components and cord condition may be missing or unsafe.
risks.proof: Photos of any motor/electrical parts and the power cord plug; plus a safety check video (no sparks/abnormal movement).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-electric/unknown electrical safety (worst-case: no working power).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the brand/model/serial plate(s) on the machine head and cabinet (including any “Two lion” marking).
Show all included accessories laid out (needle, bobbins, bobbin case, presser feet, attachments/tools) and confirm what’s missing.
Provide a short video of the machine operating: treadle/handwheel movement with feed dogs moving and needle bar action.
Upload photos of the cabinet from multiple angles (drawer open/closed, underside, back) to check for cracks/loose joints.
If there is a motor/electric conversion: show the motor, wiring, and power cord/plug, and demonstrate safe operation.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an antique-style treadle sewing machine on a wooden cabinet, but brand/model, completeness, and working condition are not confirmed. So it can be priced at the worst-case for unknown working order and possible missing accessories, with proof requests to raise the value.
